purpose: Multi-turn conversations from the four kinds of person who actually walk up to the kiosk. Single-query test sets miss everything that only breaks on the SECOND turn: a follow-up that needs the previous list, a pronoun with no antecedent, a pick after a topic change. They also miss how people really type — colloquial verb endings, dropped ZWNJ, one wrong letter.

expectations.list: a numbered choice: source local_company_search or ai_options, with options[]
expectations.answer: one recorded answer served from the knowledge base
expectations.pick: the visitor chose from the previous list: source local_pick
expectations.refuse: out of scope, or a withheld personal field — must NOT be answered
expectations.any: not asserted; recorded so a human can read what happened

turns.say: من به رباتیک علاقه دارم چیزی هست؟
